title: Framework Internal Protocol: Teaching Files vs Inbox Lugs
description: Framework receives teaching files (protocols to learn) and inbox lugs (messages). Must process each correctly.
perceive: Teaching files are protocols agents absorb. Inbox lugs are messages from hub/spokes. Framework must distinguish and process differently.
execute: Documented: Teaching files (markdown) are educational. Inbox lugs (JSON) are informational/actionable. Different processing paths.
